changes.comment: The `reply` tool now takes exactly `chat_id`, optional `message_id`, and `text`; the `mention_user_ids` argument is gone, and a mention is written in the body with Feishu's own `<at user_id="ou_example">Example</at>` syntax, which the tool description now shows. Replies are delivered as native rich text, so the authored Markdown renders as written instead of being converted into a card. Inbound mentions reach the model as `<at user_id="...">`, changed from `<at id="...">`, and are taken from the parsed message rather than recovered from its raw body. A Team the channel provisions automatically for a Collaboration Space topic is now created with the space's configured identity followed by its bound reply address — the chat and the message that triggered creation — so the leader can still address the conversation after a compaction; the space policy is unchanged. A failed send now reports the platform's own status, code, reason, and log id in the channel log and the MCP failure.
